Package com.kerosene.kfe.paymentexecution.application.result

Record Class CancellationEligibilitySnapshot

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.kerosene.kfe.paymentexecution.application.result.CancellationEligibilitySnapshot
Record Components:
executionId - participant-visible payment identity
ownerUserId - account that owns the execution
status - current execution lifecycle state
blockchainTransactionId - known chain transaction evidence affecting eligibility
paymentRequest - linked user-scoped request metadata, if the execution belongs to one
public record CancellationEligibilitySnapshot(PaymentExecutionId executionId, long ownerUserId, ExecutionStatus status, String blockchainTransactionId, PaymentRequestCancellationReference paymentRequest) extends Record
Authorized read projection for cancellation hints; excludes raw idempotency keys, invoice payloads, and credentials.
